name: Degenerator
doc: Degenerator (Gesper's enemy attack; module 174 is Quistis' Degenerator 306's code with another timeline, the caster's afterimages and sparkles): the root and the controller - the black vortex: the caster's afterimages and rising sparkles, the core, pulses, flicker, screen and target rings, the other fighters faded, the target pulled in and swallowed, the debris, the texture restore, the sound; the action result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag174_degenerator.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools, particles, afterimage poses and saves in the module, its packets in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Controller
parts.doc: The black vortex: the caster's afterimages and sparkles, the core, pulses, flicker, screen and target rings, the fades, the target pulled in and swallowed, the debris, the texture restore, the sound; the action result

params.label: Flicker
params.doc: The sprite sequence flicker (a flipbook of 1 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Debris
params.doc: The sprite sequence debris (a flipbook of 15 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Sparkles
params.doc: The sprite sequence of the sparkles rising round the caster (a flipbook of 15 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Core model
params.doc: The prim model core (a mesh of 26 vertices, 36 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Pulse model

params.label: Target ring model
params.doc: The prim model target ring (a mesh of 81 vertices, 64 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Vortex model
params.doc: The prim model vortex (a mesh of 314 vertices, 336 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Afterimage colours
params.doc: The caster's afterimages' colour words, newest first (5: red, green, blue, the GPU code byte) (20 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Vortex colours
params.doc: The vortex's colour words by its tick (12, cycling: red, green, blue, the GPU code byte) (48 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
